gradingBrief.questionTranscript:
[user]
Decompose and execute an agent plan with milestones: inspect router decisions API, compare local vs remote latency profiles, validate schema for difficultyRouting, apply patch to router.ts, and recommend routing strategy improvements.
gradingBrief.exemplarAnswer:
Coherent plan or summary addressing the tool-using task.
Tool calls: read_file, validate_schema, apply_patch with ---/+++ headers plus @@ hunk marker (line numbers optional) or Codex patch envelope
Required fields: plan, patch_summary, strategy_improvements
deliverablesChecklist: [MUST] Attempts the requested tool workflow without refusing outright.
[MUST] Emit API tool calls: read_file, validate_schema, apply_patch
[MUST] Include JSON keys: plan, patch_summary, strategy_improvements

[MUST] apply_patch must contain either ---/+++ headers plus an @@ hunk marker and real change content, or a valid Codex patch envelope with real content; line numbers are optional and bare @@ is acceptable
antiPatterns: MUST NOT use diff placeholders (----/+++, [file header])
MUST NOT emit prose-only TOOL_CALL lines without API tool_calls
MUST NOT submit reasoning prose as the graded code deliverable
MUST NOT leave apply_patch arguments as placeholder or malformed patch content
